delivery: Unreleased working-tree prototype; no commit, push, application install or version bump.

finalJavaScriptSyntax.scope: Final independent syntax pass includes the newly added browser harness.

designFindings.finding: Frozen scene plans and paired author identities can feed both engines directly. The portable reader admits real Godot and Bevy protocol 1/2 logs without Node, DOM or engine imports. Engine-local Entity handles and author filesystem paths stay outside the common model.

The existing generic executor required no Bevy-specific branch or new contract version in this round. It retains snapshot, path, artifact inventory, tool/adapter identity, owned sessions, cancellation and deadlines. The default registry adds the second trusted adapter; outer host configuration selects its tool.

The adapter owns data layout, scene-check phase, command arguments and frozen source diagnostics. A separately precompiled trusted Rust executable owns Bevy App, ECS components, queries and movement systems. Building an author project does not compile or execute author Cargo/Rust.

Bevy declares only the implemented headless subset. Image, author GDScript/Rust behaviors, window, capture, GPU and Android execution are not inferred from dependency availability. Browser actions and host requests refuse unsupported operations.

The current adapter contract is sufficient for a data-only project executed by a prebuilt trusted tool. Per-project Rust compilation, typed queries/commands, engine reflection, resource loading and render/compute access require separate scoped designs and evidence before broadening the shared contract.
designFindings.status: Design conclusion; these capabilities are not implemented.

compatibility.precisionScope: The controlled representative fixtures use exact integer positions and fixed deltas. No claim of bit-identical arbitrary floating-point physics between engines.

harnessAndVerificationNotes.issue: Initial integration assertion expected a runtime diagnostic frame for invalid data; actual tool correctly reported stderr with nonzero process exit. Harness expectation was corrected to the existing generic process failure contract.
An earlier portable-only run skipped the unavailable native tool; the final real-tool run and full app run have zero skips.
Default Godot host verification initially expected HTTP 202; the synchronous admitted plan correctly returns 200. The assertion was corrected and all five browser steps reran.
Prepared harness first referenced the wrong module path and then read a missing field from the legacy v1 golden. Harness corrections only; final packaged checks succeeded.

retainedExternalHostTool.scope: Pinned external development host tool in the local user cache; application preferences, installed Viento app and desktop sidecars unchanged. The compiled host is retained for use after temporary Cargo targets are removed.

limits: Headless App/ECS execution only; no Bevy rendering, window, image/audio/video, GPU, reflection, BRP/RPC or hot reload.
Normal sessions currently stay idle at 60 Hz; smoke supplies controlled input. No hardware keyboard or runtime input bridge was implemented.
No author Rust/GDScript compilation or behavior binding through this Bevy adapter.
Prepared desktop modules and browser workflow were tested; no new installer or installed Tauri application was tested.
Prepared mobile pure modules were evaluated; no Android device, mobile UI or Android engine execution was tested.
The trusted executable runs with current user permissions; this is not a code sandbox.
